name: Home SOC Lab – Detection Coverage
description: Technique coverage from a documented single-host Windows SOC lab. Test validation is limited to the simulated behaviors shown in the evidence.

techniques.comment: DET-T1053.005-Scheduled-Task-Create: schtasks.exe /create (Sysmon EID 1); excludes Office Click-to-Run. Validated with Atomic Red Team in Splunk lab.
DET-T1547.001-Registry-Run-Key: Value written to CurrentVersion\Run (Sysmon EID 13). Validated with Atomic Red Team in Splunk lab.
DET-T1087.001-Local-Account-Discovery: net/net1 user listing, excludes /add (Sysmon EID 1). Validated with Atomic Red Team in Splunk lab.
DET-T1059.001-PowerShell-Encoded-Command: PowerShell -e/-enc/-EncodedCommand or IEX/DownloadString (Sysmon EID 1). Validated with Atomic Red Team in Splunk lab.
DET-T1003.001-LSASS-Dump-Comsvcs: rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump (Sysmon EID 1). Validated with Atomic Red Team in Splunk lab.
